title: Native input decoding
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be an alphabet, let $k\in\mathbb N$, choose $a_0\in\Gamma$, and let $u$ be an optional symbol of the enlarged sweep alphabet. If $u$ is first mapped to a data symbol by retracting it to $\Gamma$, then the sweep-input decoder returns exactly the optional retracted symbol: $\operatorname{decode}(\operatorname{map}(u))=\operatorname{map}(\operatorname{retract}_{a_0}(u))$.
hypotheses_covered: An optional symbol of the enlarged sweep alphabet
